title: Gaussian polynomials in the Hermite span
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and every real polynomial $P$ in $n$ variables, the element of Gaussian $L^2(\mathbb R^n)$ represented by $P$ belongs to the real linear span of the multivariate Hermite functions.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a real multivariate polynomial in $n$ variables
